sources.title: Few-Shot Multimodal Medical Imaging: A Theoretical Framework
sources.snippet: Furthermore, few studies have examined how interactions among modalities influence learnability and generalization. Establishing a rigorous information-theoretic foundation for multimodal learning is therefore essential to guide model design and interpretation in medical applications.

sources.title: Few-Shot Multimodal Medical Imaging: A Theoretical Framework
sources.snippet: Existing multimodal and meta learning approaches improve performance in these settings but lack a theoretical explanation of why or when they succeed. This paper presents a unified theoretical framework for few shot multimodal medical imaging that jointly characterizes sample complexity, uncertainty quantification, and interpretability.

sources.title: Few-shot Multi-Label Learning for Anterior Segment Eye ... - Springer
sources.snippet: The work [5] Few-shot learning for skin diseases. They proposed a proto-typical network for dermatology. The model learned from a few examples per skin condition. It used episodic training to simulate few-shot scenarios. Their method worked well on the ISIC skin lesion dataset. But there are important limitations.
